prompt: A garden scene with a gardener tending to plants. The gardener is kneeling, holding a watering can and watering plants in a flower bed. In the bed, there are three red roses and a patch of yellow tulips; the number of yellow tulips is twice the number of red roses. A butterfly is landing on one of the red roses. Next to the flower bed, there is a vegetable garden with ripe tomatoes growing on stakes. The number of ripe tomatoes is one less than the number of red roses. A rabbit is hiding behind a large rock near the vegetable garden. The gardener is pointing at the rabbit. A wheelbarrow filled with soil sits next to a new garden shed. A shovel, showing signs of rust and wear, is leaning against the garden shed; the shovel is visibly older than the new shed. A bird is perched on top of the shed. The watering can is larger than the bird. A garden hose is coiled on the ground next to the wheelbarrow.
